introHtml: Business card buttons combine the practicality of a traditional business card with the wearability of a button, making them ideal for trade shows and networking events. Unlike standard stickers or patches, these double-sided cards offer space for your contact info on one side and a logo or message on the other. Choose from round or square shapes, pin or magnet backs, and full-color printing to ensure your brand stands out. Perfect for marketing directors and small business owners looking for a memorable giveaway that stays with recipients.
